unit_note: USD millions. Page 26, Table 6 Schedule C, Borrowing from the US Treasury: Labor, State, Transportation, Treasury and Veterans Affairs. Federal Railroad Administration: Other prints only dots and (**) and is left out. Three lines print amounts for This Month (the TIFIA fund, the Railroad Rehabilitation and Improvement Loan Fund and the Federal Financing Bank Revolving Fund), giving 6 roll-forwards (4 exact, 2 within 1; rounding note on p27). Dots and (**) are omitted.
